args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified; v2.3.0 is now serving in all regions. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the failure cause is diagnosed.
args.title: checkout-api: rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy after deploy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but only in staging).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed and was verified.
3. **Confirmed health**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with a low error rate (0.2%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and current healthy status. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is identified.
